text: I think I have a high fever
There is soreness in my throat
My throat feels painful and sore
It is hard for me to breathe
I feel sick to my stomach
I feel tired all the time
I am exhausted even after sleeping
I have lost weight without trying
My weight has dropped over the past months
I keep losing weight for no reason
I've lost weight recently without dieting
I can feel my heart pounding
My whole body has muscle aches
I have pain in muscles throughout my body
I have swelling in my legs
Part of my body is puffy
I noticed swelling in my feet
I threw up many times today
I lost my sense of smell
My sense of smell is gone
